podcast.body: The lead single from "Scary Monsters," this song was a cheeky continuation of the story of Bowie's beloved character, Major Tom, picturing him "knocking aimlessly through the far reaches of space while strung out on a kind of galactic heroine," singing "we know Major Tom's a junkie." Promoted with a colorful, high-concept, and very expensive music video (reportedly £250,000) that premiered on "Top of the Pops," it became Bowie's fastest-selling UK single ever, rising to number one in two weeks. In the US, it was a total flop, bubbling under the Hot 100 at number 101, due to its alignment with pre-MTV British New Wave sounds that hadn't yet crossed over. "Ashes to Ashes was a cheeky continuation of the story of the doomed astronaut, picturing him knocking aimlessly through the far reaches of space while strung out on a kind of galactic heroine."
